difficulty_reason: The proof itself turns additive closure of the complementary exponent set into support constraints for log(f/g), preserves them through exp, and chooses a partial-fraction expansion whose missing coefficients form a generalized Vandermonde system. The resulting generic uniqueness recovers elementary symmetric functions rationally from the selected power sums. This construction connects the combinatorial condition to field generation and is not borne only by a cited theorem.
